questions.question: A bought a toy at a discount of 35%. If he paid Rs. 975, then find the marked price of the toy.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Discount percentage is 35%

Selling price of the toy is 975Rs

**Calculation:**

Let the marked price be M

The selling price is 35% less than marked price 

Which implies selling price is 100-35=65% of the marked price

=(65)/(100)times M=975

Solving this we get M as 1500Rs.

**The marked price of the toy is Rs. 1500**

questions.question: Calculate the 3rd proportional to 14 and 28.
questions.solution:
**Theory:**

The third proportional means the three numbers are in same proportion to each 

Let three numbers a, b, c

Then a:b::b:c

**Calculation:**

(a)/(b)=(b)/(c)

Thus we can write c=(b²)/(a)

Here a=14 , b=28

c==(28²)/(14)=56

**∴ The third proportional is 56**

questions.question: Expand x² + 2x + 3 about x = - 2.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x² + 2x + 3

x = –2

**Calculation:**

x = – 2

⇒ x + 2 = 0

Now we have to expand only options 2 and 3,

As in options 1 and 4, the first term is (x - 2)

Expanding option 2, 

⇒ (x + 2)2 – 2(x + 2) + 3

⇒ x² + 4x + 4 - 2x - 4 + 3

⇒ x² + 2x + 3

Hence it gives the given expression, 

**∴ Option 2 is correct.**

x = – 2

⇒ x + 2 = 0

If we consider option 3, substituting x + 2 instead of x,

⇒ x2 + 4x + 4 + 2x + 4 + 3

⇒ x2 + 6x + 11 

Hence it is not equal to the x2 + 2x + 3 (given expression)

∴ Option 3 can not be the answer.

questions.question: The marked price of 42 items was equal to the cost price of 70 items. The selling price of 25 items was equal to the marked price of 21 items. Calculate the percentage profit or loss from the sale of each item.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of MP to CP = 70 ÷ 42 = 5/3

Ratio of SP to MP = 21 ÷ 25

Multiply both ratios to find SP/CP: (SP/MP) × (MP/CP) = (21/25) × (5/3) = 7/5

Profit % = [(SP − CP) / CP] × 100 = [(7 − 5) / 5] × 100 = 40%

**∴ The correct answer is 40%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

42 × Marked Price (MP) = 70 × Cost Price (CP)

25 × Selling Price (SP) = 21 × Marked Price (MP)

**Formula Used:**

Profit = SP − CP

Profit % = (Profit / CP) × 100

questions.question: The average weight of 8 men is increased by 2 kg when one of them, whose weight is 90 kg, is replaced by another man. What is the weight of the new man?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net change in total weight = Total members × Increase in average

Net change = 8 × 2 = 16 kg

Since the average increases, the new man is heavier than the replaced man.

Weight of new man = Weight of replaced man + Net change

Weight of new man = 90 + 16 = 106 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 106 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total number of men = 8

Increase in average weight = 2 kg

Weight of replaced man = 90 kg

 
 Old Man (90 kg)
 
 + 16 kg
 

 8 men × 2 kg
 

 New Man = 106 kg

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of observations ÷ Number of observations

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let original average weight of 8 men be A.

⇒ Total original weight = 8 × A = 8A

⇒ After replacing, the new average becomes (A + 2).

⇒ Total new weight = 8 × (A + 2) = 8A + 16

⇒ Increase in total weight = (8A + 16) − 8A = 16 kg

⇒ This 16 kg increase is strictly due to the weight difference between the new and replaced man.

⇒ Weight of new man = Weight of replaced man + Increase in total weight

⇒ Weight of new man = 90 + 16 = 106 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 106 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Replacement in Averages

When one member is replaced, the weight of the new member can be calculated directly:
New Value = Old Value + (Total Members × Increase in Average)
New Value = Old Value − (Total Members × Decrease in Average)

Addition of a New Member

When a new member joins the group:
New Member = Old Average + (Total Members after addition × Increase in Average)

Removal of a Member

When a member leaves the group:
Removed Member = Old Average − (Remaining Members × Increase in Average)

questions.question: The population of a city increases by 10% annually. If its present population is 21,000, what will be the population in 3 years?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

percentage change in population is 10%

present population is 21000

**formula used:**

Population after n years = P=p(1+(r)/(100))^n

where P is the population to be found

p is the population now

r is the rate of increase

n is the number of years

**Calculation**

P=21000(1+(10)/(100))³

⇒ P = 21,000 × (11/10)³

⇒ P = 21,000 × 11/10 × 11/10 × 11/10

⇒ P = 21 × 11 × 11 × 11 = 27,951

questions.question: A motorcycle covers 50 km at a speed of 25 km/h. Find the speed of the motorcycle for the next 50 km of the journey so that the average speed of the whole journey will be 30 km/h.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average speed is 30km/h

Speed which covers 1st 50 km is 25km/h

**Formula used:**

average speed = (2times x times y)/(x+y)

where x and y are speeds

**Calculation:**

x = 25km/h

substituting the equation

average speed = 30 = (2times 25 times y)/(25+y)

solving we get y = 37.5km/h

**The speed for the next 50km will be 37.5km/hr**.

questions.question: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 15?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Four number are given.

**Formula used:**

If the sum of the digits of a number are divisible by three, then the number is divisible by 3.

If the digit at one's place of a number is either 5 or 0, then the number is divisible by 5.

**Calculation:**

The factors of 15 are 3 and 5. Therefore, for a given number to be divisible by 15, it must be divisible by both, 3 and 5.

Since the last digit of all the given options is 5, all of them are divisible by 5.

To check which of the numbers is divisible by 3.

Option 1: 1+6+5+4+8+5 = 28, which is not divisible by 3.

Option 2: 3+0+6+0+4+5 = 18, which is divisible by 3.

Option 3: 2+1+2+6+9+5 = 25, which is not divisible by 3.

Option 4: 2+9+5+1+4+5 = 2, which is not divisible by 3. 

**Therefore, the number which is divisible by 15 is 3,06,045.**

questions.question: Arun alone can finish a work in 12 days and Shama alone can do it in 15 days. How much time will be taken to finish the work, if Arun and Shama work together?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Arun can finish a work in 12 days and Shama can finish in 15 days.

**Formula used:**

Time taken for A and B together, to do a work is (xy)/(x+y), where

x is the time taken by A alone, and

y is the time taken by B alone.

**Calculation:**

Here, x = 12 days and y = 15 days.

**Therefore, time taken to finish the work, if Arun and Shama work together is (12 times 15)/(12+15) = (12 times 15)/(27) =(20)/(3) =6 (2)/(3) days.**

questions.question: Using 2cosA cosB = cos(A + B) + cos(A – B), find the value of cos75°cos15°.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Directly apply the **Product-to-Sum formula**: cos A cos B = 1/2 [cos(A + B) + cos(A − B)]

Here, A = 75° and B = 15°.

Value = 1/2 × [cos(75° + 15°) + cos(75° − 15°)] = 1/2 × [cos 90° + cos 60°]

Since **cos 90° = 0** and **cos 60° = 1/2**, the result is 1/2 × (0 + 1/2) = 1/4.

**∴ The correct answer is 1/4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Angles A = 75° and B = 15°. Formula: **2cosA cosB = cos(A + B) + cos(A − B)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89f43fbce5221832211f9a0841fc0119a0989741ba6a3d1d0c75491c0679dd5c.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ cos 75° cos 15° = 1/2 × [2 cos 75° cos 15°]

⇒ Applying the **identity**: cos 75° cos 15° = 1/2 × [cos(75° + 15°) + cos(75° − 15°)]

⇒ cos 75° cos 15° = 1/2 × [cos 90° + cos 60°]

⇒ Substitute standard values: **cos 90° = 0** and **cos 60° = 1/2**

⇒ cos 75° cos 15° = 1/2 × [0 + 1/2]

⇒ cos 75° cos 15° = 1/2 × 1/2 = 1/4

**∴ The correct answer is 1/4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Other Product-to-Sum Identities

2 sin A sin B = cos(A − B) − cos(A + B)

Mixed Sine and Cosine Products

2 sin A cos B = sin(A + B) + sin(A − B)

Standard Values for Reference

For standard trigonometric calculations: sin 30° = 1/2, cos 30° = √3/2, sin 60° = √3/2, and sin 90° = 1.</p

questions.question: Find the volume of the cuboid, if its length is thrice its breadth and its breadth is 8 cm, which is twice its height.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The length of a cuboid is twice more than its breadth and its breadth is 8 cm, which is twice its height.

**Formula used:**

Volume of cuboid = length × breadth × height 

**Calculation:**

If breadth is 8cm, then the height is (8)/(2)=4cm.

If length is thrice its breadth, the length is 8 × 3 = 24cm.

**∴ The volume of the cuboid is 24 × 8 × 4 = 768cm³.**

questions.question: Under a sale offer for an item, Mahesh was offered 24% discount on the part of the marked price that was paid in cash, but was charged 1.5% on the part of the marked price paid through a credit card. If Mahesh paid 40% of the marked price in cash and the rest through a credit card and his total final payment was ₹6,391, what was the marked price of the item?
questions.solution:
**Formula used:**

Discounted price = frac{ {100 - discount}}{100} times {marked price}

**Calculation:**

Let the marked price be x.

The amount paid in cash with 24% discount is 74% of 40% of x,

⇒ 0.76 times 0.4 times x .

The amount paid with credit card with charge of 1.5% is 101.5% of 60% of x

⇒ 1.015 times 0.6 times x .

Then, the total amount paid is 

⇒ 0.76 times 0.4 times x + 1.015 times 0.6 times x = 6391.

Solving for x,

0.304x+0.609x=6391

x=(6391)/(0.913) = 7000

**∴ The marked price of the item is Rs. 7000.**

questions.question: Ali and Badal start from the same position and at the same time in a 1200 m circular race, with speeds of 27 km/h and 45 km/h, respectively. Find after how much time they will meet again on the track for the first time when they are both running in the same direction.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ali and Badal start from the same position and at the same time in a 1200 m circular race, with speeds of 27 km/h and 45 km/h, respectively. 

**Calculations:**

Relative speed of both in same direction = S2-S1=45 - 27 =18 km/h = 18 × (5/18) = 5 m/s.

So,

Time taken by them to meet for the first time on the track while running in same direction = Length of track / relative speed in same direction = 1200/5= 240 seconds 

**Hence, The Required time is 240 seconds.**

questions.question: A man spends 15% of his income on house rent, 60% of the rest on household expenses and saves the rest. If he saves ₹52,500, what is his total income (in ₹, rounded off to the nearest tens)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A man spends 15% of his income on house rent, 60% of the rest on household expenses and saves the rest.

**Formula used:**

Savings = total income - Total expenses 

**Calculation:**

Let the person's total income be x.

Then, the amount he spends on house rent is 0.15x

The amount he spends on households expenses is 0.6 × 0.15x

Therefore, the amount he save is (x - 0.15x - 0.6 × 0.15x) = 52500.

Solving for x,

0.34x = 52500

x=(52500)/(0.34)=154411.74

**∴ The total income rounded off to the nearest tens is Rs. 1,54,410**

questions.question: The area of a triangle whose perimeter is 36 cm and length of two sides is 17 cm and 9 cm will be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The perimeter of a triangle is 36 cm.

The length of two sides is 17 cm and 9 cm.

**Formula used:**

Area of triangle = sqrt{s(s - a) (s - b) (s - c)} 

where '2s' is the perimeter of the triangle and a, b, c are the triangle's three sides.

Perimeter of a triangle is 2s = a + b + c

**Calculation:**

The perimeter is 36 cm and the length of two sides is 17 cm
 and 9 cm, then the length of the third side is 36 - (17 + 9) = 10 cm.

This means that s = 18cm, a = 17cm, b = 9cm, c = 10cm

**∴ The area of the given triangle is sqrt {18(18-17)(18-9)(18-10)}=36cm²**
